headline: **MLB Daily Recap: July 4, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 6-1 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Carmen Mlodzinski earning the win. Nick Gonzales led the Pirates' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance. In other action, the Cincinnati Reds defeated the Milwaukee Brewers 7-2, the Colorado Rockies routed the Miami Marlins 14-4, and the Cleveland Guardians edged the Chicago White Sox 6-5.

Several players have been placed on the injured list, including Freddy Fermin of the San Diego Padres, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a head contusion. Other players on the injured list include Julio Rodríguez of the Seattle Mariners, Cooper Criswell of the Seattle Mariners, Ryan Helsley of the Baltimore Orioles, Bennett Sousa of the Houston Astros, Carlos Rodón of the New York Yankees, and Jason Adam of the San Diego Padres.

There have been several trades and roster moves, including the Houston Astros trading Tom Cosgrove to the Washington Nationals for cash, the Baltimore Orioles trading Kyle Nicolas to the Washington Nationals for Randal Diaz, and the Athletics trading Brett Harris to the Boston Red Sox for Ben Hansen.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Phillies 6-1**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 6-1 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Carmen Mlodzinski earning the win. Nick Gonzales led the Pirates' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Brewers 7-2**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 7-2 victory over the Milwaukee Brewers, led by a strong performance from their offense. Jose Trevino led the Reds' batting effort with 3 hits, including a home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rockies Rout Marlins 14-4**
top_news.summary: The Colorado Rockies dominated the Miami Marlins, winning 14-4 behind a strong team effort. Jake McCarthy led the Rockies' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Guardians Edge White Sox in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a 6-5 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Tim Herrin earning the win. Brayan Rocchio led the Guardians' offense, hitting a crucial home run in the game.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Rout Cubs 17-1 in Dominant Performance**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals secured a convincing 17-1 victory over the Chicago Cubs, with multiple players contributing to the team's high-scoring effort. Iván Herrera, Alec Burleson, Masyn Winn, Bryan Torres, José Fermín, Blaze Jordan, Nathan Church, and Alex Bregman all had notable performances in the win.

top_news.title: **Padres Place Freddy Fermin on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: San Diego Padres catcher Freddy Fermin has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a head contusion. The move was made on July 3, 2026.

top_news.title: **Nationals Acquire LHP Tom Cosgrove in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals have acquired left-handed pitcher Tom Cosgrove in a trade with the Houston Astros. The deal was made for cash considerations.
